findings: Dorn catalog identifies DP1417 with Camwell credit under soprano/piano.
June Emerson explicitly lists soprano or tenor saxophone with piano.

Paganini's underlying work is Introduction/Theme and Variations, Op.12, based on Rossini's La Cenerentola aria. Schott's violin/piano Kreisler edition establishes this source-work identity, but its arrangement is a different edition.

evidence.claim: Original source work Op.12 and separate Kreisler edition
